results.title: PGA National Golf Club
results.text: PGA National Golf Club, the home of the Professional Golfers' Association of America, is in the southeastern United States, located at the PGA National Resort & Spa in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. The golf facilities include five championship 18-hole courses, four within the main resort ground and another 5 mi west. The resort was acquired in August 2006 by Century Golf Partners in conjunction with Walton Street Capital, LLC and SCS Advisors, Inc.

results.title: PGA National Champion Course
results.text: The PGA National Champion Course is an 18-hole golf course located in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, USA.

results.title: 1971 PGA Championship
results.text: The 1971 PGA Championship was the 53rd PGA Championship, played February 25–28 at the original PGA National Golf Club, presently known as BallenIsles Country Club (East Course) in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida.

results.title: Palm Beach Gardens, Florida
results.text: Palm Beach Gardens is a city in Palm Beach County in the U.S. state of Florida. As of the 2010 United States Census , the population was 48,452. The city has a number of gated communities.

results.title: North Palm Beach County General Aviation Airport
results.text: North Palm Beach County Airport (FAA LID: F45) , also known as North County Airport, is an uncontrolled general aviation airport located 12 nautical miles (22 km) northwest of West Palm Beach off the Bee Line Highway in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. The airport is owned by Palm Beach County and operated by the Palm Beach County Airports Department.

results.title: 2004 Palm Beach Gardens Challenger
results.text: The 2004 Palm Beach Gardens Challenger was a women's professional tennis tournament played on clay courts. It was the 2nd edition of the Palm Beach Gardens Challenger, and was an ITF $50,000 tournament from 2003–2005. It took place at the Palm Beach Gardens Tennis Center in Florida from November 29 to Dec 5, 2004.
